reports.description: Bitindexfarm.net is a bloody rip-off. For example. Say you invest $500 into their Plan B, you are supposed to get 50% returns on investment in 48hours. After 48hours when you withdraw, they will tell you that you have been placed on auto-invest, you cannot have your money yet. It will be re-invested for anther 48hrs. You will only be able to get it in 48hrs. Ok, you will wait, 48hrs later, you will try to withdraw, and they will tell you that you will only be able to withdraw when you get to Plan D. So, how do you get to plan D? They will ask you to invest a kick-starter of $500. Youll ask the obvious question, how are you sure there are no other fees or to-do waiting to blindside you at the next corner. They will assure you that when you invest the $500 kickstarter, your investment will migrate automatically to the next plan until plan D after spending twice the time on each investment plan. I hope you wont be foolish as me to invest the $500 kickstarter. But if you are na√Øve like me. You will invest. By the time your investment has made 48hrs x 2 on plan C, everything will come to a screeching halt. When you contact them to ask whats up, they will ask you to pay another kick-starter of $1000 to move to plan D. When you try to protest that they swore and assured you that there was no other condition left for you to fulfil. Theyll conveniently apologize that it was a mix-up, misinformation. Now if you are so stupid like me, you will invest the $1000, You will get to plan D and stay there for 10days. Hurray it‚Äôs time to withdraw your huge returns. Ah, not so fast. Theres another catch. I could explain their entire operation here, except that I am limited in this description to 2000 characters.

reports.description: 06 August 2020 - I received a cold call from a person named Jamie Thompson. He said he was calling from a company called Coinibank.com. He said it would only cost 250USD, and I could start making money, which I agreed to. I transferred the money and he then put me onto a personal Financial Advisor called Christopher Emerson. I agreed after a period of time to transfer more funds, and with Christopher‚Äôs help on ‚ÄòAny desk‚Äô, this was completed. Everything went well. Christopher then told me he needed an operation, and I was handed on to another financial advisor by the name of Natalie Wood. I traded with Natalie, and deposited more funds with the promise of better signals/bigger profits, which showed on the platform. We got to a point on their platform where she said we couldn‚Äôt go any further, unless I went ‚ÄúVIP‚Äù The profit showing total of 69,132.97Euro at this stage. I said I wished to withdraw the money instead, and that was when they demanded a 25% liquidation fee to release funds to my CEX.10 wallet. I paid 17,000Euro as a fee. The last deposit was made on 29 Jan 2021 through CEX wallet, then emails went quiet ‚Äì no more correspondence! 18 Feb 2021 - There have now been more than 15 working days without any reply from Coinibank. I am very upset, as I have foolishly invested all my own and my partner‚Äôs savings in this.
